idea-plugin.name: Service Invocation Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
This is a lightweight Idea plug-in that monitors the link calls of Junit and SpringBoot applications and counts the time spent on interface methods with zero intrusion. It helps developers see the timing of the call chain more visually when debugging code, and optimizes performance ahead of time.

这是一款轻量级的Idea插件，也是我个人开发的第一个插件。

可以零侵入地做到对SpringBoot应用程序调用链路的监控，统计接口方法的耗时。它可以帮助开发人员在调试代码时更直观地看到调用链的时间，提前对性能做一些优化处理。

如果觉得插件好用，感谢给个好评！🙏🙏🙏 大家的认可是插件更新的动力！
插件地址：https://github.com/caijianying/Service-invocation-monitor
演示项目地址：https://github.com/caijianying/Service-invocation-monitor-demo
idea-plugin.change-notes:
V20261017

  • Feature: Added stack trace search & highlight navigation bar (Ctrl+F) with occurrence counter and ActionToolbar in Monitor ToolWindow
  • Feature: Filtered and suppressed Java standard runtime classes (java.*, javax.*, sun.*, jdk.*) from trace outputs with smooth child span promotion
  • Feature: Enhanced bytecode interceptor boundaries and AgentBuilder ignore rules to skip Java standard classes

V20261016 (Latest Optimization & Modern Platform Upgrade)

  • Build System: Upgraded to modern IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x (org.jetbrains.intellij.platform 2.19.0) with official 2026.2.3 SDK
  • API Modernization: Implemented ActionUpdateThread.BGT in MonitorOutPutWindowAction to prevent UI freezes
  • API Modernization: Implemented DumbAware on tool windows and actions for seamless responsiveness during indexing
  • Performance: Optimized trace tree building from O(N^2) to O(N) by parentSpanId grouping
  • Performance: Replaced full-file log reading with incremental byte-offset reading to avoid UI freezes
  • Performance: Cached agent jar path and upgraded method filter lookups to O(1) Sets
  • Security: Replaced shared static activeSpanIdMap with per-trace concurrent collections and per-thread Deque
  • Security: Fixed method exception leak via try-finally cleanup in bytecode interceptors
  • Security: Sanitized projectCode in FileCache to protect against path traversal (CWE-22)
  • Compatibility: Compatible with latest IntelliJ IDEA (2026.x) using modern ContentFactory and ToolWindowManagerListener
  • Compatibility: Fixed Project memory leak via Disposer registration and fixed duplicate addContent
  • Compatibility: Restored sampleRate in ToolsSetting.loadState and fixed ToolsConfiguration.isModified()
